author: Krono II
title: GNN Paradigm Shift: Validate Graph Construction Utility
abstract: This is a validation-only submission to test the core pre-processing step for a new GNN-based research paradigm. It does not run any training. It uses a test() function to execute a new `build_graph_from_obs` utility on a dummy observation and prints the resulting graph tensors to STDOUT. This confirms the foundational logic before building the full network.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/krono')
from graph_utils import build_graph_from_obs
import jax.numpy as jnp

# This submission only runs the test() function. No training will occur.
def test():
    # Create a dummy observation batch (B=1, H=8, W=8, C=8).
    obs = jnp.zeros((1, 8, 8, 8))
    
    # Place agent at (2,2) and boxes at (3,2) and (4,4).
    obs = obs.at[0, 2, 2, 3].set(1.0)
    obs = obs.at[0, 3, 2, 4].set(1.0)
    obs = obs.at[0, 4, 4, 4].set(1.0)
    
    print("--- Dummy Observation Created ---")
    print(f"Agent at (2,2), Boxes at (3,2) and (4,4)")
    
    # Call the new graph construction function.
    nodes, adj, mask = build_graph_from_obs(obs, max_entities=5)
    
    print("\n--- Graph Construction Output ---")
    print(f"Node Features Shape: {nodes.shape}")
    print(f"Adjacency Matrix Shape: {adj.shape}")
    print(f"Mask Shape: {mask.shape}")
    
    # Print the results for the first (and only) item in the batch.
    print("\n--- Node Features (y, x, is_agent, is_box) ---")
    print(nodes[0])
    
    print("\n--- Adjacency Matrix ---")
    print(adj[0])
    
    print("\n--- Mask ---")
    print(mask[0])
    
    return "Graph utility test complete. Check STDOUT for results."
